findings.evidence: Lines 124–128 prove it solely with `rw [Valuation.embedding_restrict, coarsenByUnits_apply]`; grep finds uses only at lines 186–187 of the same file.
findings.fix: Remove it or make it private and use `simp` at the internal call site; the canonical component lemmas already provide this reduction.
findings.issue: `embedding_restrict_coarsenByUnits` is an over-exposed implementation helper: its statement follows directly by simplification from the existing `@[simp]` lemmas `Valuation.embedding_restrict` and `coarsenByUnits_apply`, and its only grep hits are its declaration and one proof in this file.

findings.evidence: Lines 147–152 state `(v.coarsenByUnits H).supp = v.supp`, oriented from the constructed valuation to its underlying valuation.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` so expressions involving the support of a coarsened valuation normalize to `v.supp`.
findings.issue: `coarsenByUnits_supp` is the characteristic normal-form theorem for support preservation but is not marked `@[simp]`.

summary: The main continuity and cofinality APIs are appropriately exposed, but the coarsening interface contains one redundant public proof helper and lacks automation on its support normal form.
